title: Ultimate Key Lock
description: Allows to lock Doors and Containers with Trial Keys!
body:
## ✨ Context
This mod simply allows to use **Trial Keys** and **Ominous Trial Keys** to lock blocks and entities.  
By default on: **Doors**, **Trapdoors**, **Fence Gates**, **Barrels** and all  **Chests** variants including Boats and Minecart.
  
****

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dwkL9DABO9Y" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>  

****
  
# 🗝️ FEATURES
### 🔒 Locking
**- Trial Keys on any lockable block will prevent interaction with it.**  
Chests will no longer open (protecting their inventory), neither will doors. 
  
**- Ominous Trial Keys will still allow the Owner (the Player who used it) to interact with the block, without needing the key.**  
This means they can even destroy the key and have exclusive access to a Chest or Trapdoor. 
  
**- With either Key, the block becomes unminable by both players and mobs.**  
Villagers and Zombies cannot break locked doors. This truly protects your build and adds lore!  
  
**- Keys will be given a unique ID upon first use, similar to vanilla maps.**  
The Id only exists for tracking and helping players sort their keys.  
  
**- Keys will also be automatically renamed based on their bound block, most languages are supported!**  
Even better: you can still rename the keys at any moment and your custom name will have priority over the automatic rename.  
****  
### 🔓 Unlocking
**- Using the same key on the bound block will unlock it.**  
**- The key will lose its autoname but will retain its ID and custom name.**  
****
### ⚡ Redstone
**- Dispensers can use Keys to lock blocks.**  
Use your imagination to create automated locking systems or more :)  
  
**- Locked blocks and entities will NOT react to Redstone!**  
That means buttons will not be able to open doors, hoppers will not pass items down to a locked chest etc.  

**- Copper Golems will ignore locked chests.**  
Again, allows complex automation using dispensers and hoppers.
****
### 💥 Removal
**- Locked Blocks are unbreakable / unmineable. This means the only way to remove them is:**  
  
**1) Unlocking with the unique key**  
**2) An explosion (TNT, Creeper...)**  
**3) Creative mode**  
This choice was made so locked blocks are not overpowered, while still offering advantages at low risk.  
****
### 🔏 Lockable
**The following blocks and entities are lockable:**
- Doors
- Trapdoors
- Fence Gates
- Chests
- Copper Chests variants
- Barrels
- Minecart with Chest
- Boats with Chest
- Cabinets (Farmers Delight)

**Note: Double Doors and Trapdoors will be locked together!** 
  
****
## 🌐 Supported Languages
**The autoname mechanic is supported in the following languages:**
- **繁體中文** (Traditional Chinese)
- **简体中文** (Simplified Chinese)
- **Dansk** (Danish)
- **Nederlands** (Dutch)
- **English**
- **Eesti** (Estonian)
- **Français** (All French dialects)
- **Deutsch** (German)
- **Italiano** (Italian)
- **Íslenska** (Icelandic)
- **日本語** (Japanese)
- **한국어** (Korean)
- **Norsk** (All Norwegian dialects)
- **Português** (Portuguese & Brazilian Portuguese)
- **Русский** (Russian)
- **Español** (All Spanish dialects)
- **Svenska** (Swedish)
- **ไทย** (Thai)
- **Tiếng Việt** (Vietnamese)
- **Українська** (Ukrainian)

****
## ⚙️ No configuration required, ready to use!
****
## 🔗 Compatibility
- Compatible with most Double Doors/Trapdoors mods.
- Compatible with Biomes o Plenty and Farmers Delight!
- Also compatible with most mods that add variants of doors, trapdoors or containers that register under chests!
